jobs_results.description:
What's Ditto?

Ditto’s mission is to help people make well-informed insurance decisions - from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry-first “No-spam” policy, and over the past five years, we’ve assisted over 700,000 users with personalised advice on health and term insurance. We carry a 4.9 rating with 32,000+ reviews on Google.

Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We won LinkedIn’s Top Startup award in both 2022 and 2023.




Responsibilities

Architect and build end-to-end backend services and APIs.Integrate with external systems such as insurers, payment gateways, and other partners.Ensure high observability, performance, and reliability across systems.Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code with a focus on scalability.Implement comprehensive test coverage and maintain code quality.Manage database design, migrations, scripting, and administration.


Experience & Skills

2-8 years of experience in backend development.Hands-on experience with low-level & high-level system design.Proven experience building scalable, secure backend systems (APIs, middleware, caching).Proficiency in Python, Django, Django REST Framework (DRF), PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and basic HTML/CSS.Experience developing RESTful APIs.Familiarity with AWS or other major cloud platforms is a plus.Strong sense of ownership, problem-solving ability, and leadership qualities.


Perks

Comprehensive health and term insuranceESOPsCompensation as per industry standards


Our Interview Process: 

We value your time and aim to complete the process within 3 weeks, consisting of the following stages:

The schedule is as follows:

HR Introductory RoundTech-Connect RoundLive Coding Round 1 - onlineLive Coding Round 2 -(in office)Founders round


This is an in-office role. Our address is: Fortuna-1, No 680, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar 2nd phase, J P Nagar, Bangalore, Bangalore South - 560078, Karnataka, India




Please Note: Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees at any stage of the hiring process. If you receive any suspicious message claiming to be from Ditto, please verify through our official channels.

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer III (Python / Go)
jobs_results.description:
As an SDE3 Backend Engineer, you will take technical ownership of complex backend components, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability of our systems. You will serve as a go-to engineer for challenging problems, mentor junior developers, and play an active role in shaping system architecture and technical direction.




Responsibilities: 

Design and Development: Architect and implement scalable backend services and APIs using Python or Golang, ensuring high performance, resilience, and extensibility.System Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership of critical modules, from design and development to deployment and support.Technical Leadership: Conduct design and code reviews, enforce best practices, and mentor junior engineers to raise the team's technical bar.Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, architects, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.Performance and Reliability: Troubleshoot complex issues in production systems, identify root causes, and design sustainable long-term solutions.Innovation: Evaluate new technologies, contribute to proofs-of-concept, and recommend tools that can improve developer productivity.Process Improvement: Drive initiatives to improve coding standards, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing practices.Knowledge Sharing: Document designs, create technical guides, and share insights with the broader engineering team.


Requirements: 

4-7 years of backend development experience with Python or Golang.Strong expertise in designing, developing, and scaling microservices and distributed systems.Solid understanding of concurrency, multi-threading, and performance optimization.Proficiency with databases (SQL/NoSQL), caching systems (Redis, Memcached), and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc. ).Hands-on experience with Linux development, Docker, and Kubernetes.Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and related services.Strong debugging, profiling, and optimization skills for production-grade systems.Experience with AI-powered development tools is a strong plus; familiarity with concepts like 'agentic coding' for workflow automation or 'context engineering' for leveraging LLMs in system design is highly desirable.


Required Skills: 

Strong problem-solving ability, with experience handling complex technical challenges.Ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers.Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and articulate trade-offs.Self-motivated, proactive, and able to operate independently while aligning with team goals.Passionate about engineering culture, quality, and developer productivity.

jobs_results.title: Senior Back-End Developer - Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
About the Role

At Driivz, AI-augmented development is how we work — not an experiment, not a bonus skill. Our BackEnd team builds and ships complex features using agentic AI tools as a core part of the development loop: from research and architecture through implementation, testing, and code review.

You'll join a team building a white-label EV charging platform used by 40+ global brands. The app handles real-time charging sessions, multi-gateway payments, geolocation, and operator-branded experiences — all in a multi-module Kotlin codebase undergoing active MVI and Compose migrations.

As a Senior Back End Developer (Python), you'll own the full delivery lifecycle: designing and shipping complex new features, driving legacy-to-modern migrations and contributing to platform and build system health — all with AI as your co-pilot.

INTRODUCTION and WHAT YOU WILL DO (Job Responsibilities)Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV Charging and Energy Management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers. 

We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that enables our clients to efficiently manage their networks and provide EV drivers with exceptional charging experience. 

Operating in over 35 countries in the US, Europe and Asia, we enable hundreds of millions of events for millions of EV drivers and manage more than 160,000 public chargers (100,000s in roaming). 

Our customers include global industry leaders such as EVgo, Volvo Group, Shell, Circle K, Mer, Recharge, Kople, ESB, CEZ, MOL Group, ST1, and eMobility Power. 

Join our team to work alongside the most brilliant and disruptive minds that are focused on leading the eMobility industry and building a greener world.

For more information, please visit http://www.driivz.com

WHO YOU ARE (Qualifications)Design and build agentic services and AI-augmented platform capabilities - context and harness engineering, plus tool and MCP integrations that connect LLMs to core systems.Own reliability end to end: build the evals, guardrails, and observability that make those systems measurable and production-grade, not just demos.Enhance core capabilities in LOB areas such as Billing and CRM - including through AI-augmented workflows and services.What should you have?

Experienced Backend Developer.Proven Python experience (Min 5+ Years).Proven AI Engineering experience (Context/Harness engineering, Tools, MCP, etc).Experience making agentic/LLM systems reliable in production - evaluation suites, guardrails, and observability.Proven experience with Microservices Architecture.Proven experience in SaaS multitenant high throughput systems.Proven experience with a Relational Databases (MySQL/Postgres, etc.)Experience with Docker.Team player with extensive experience working in teams.Advantages:

Agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, etc.) - and comfort building directly on LLM primitives when lighter-weight suits the problem better.Python AI/web frameworks: FastAPI, FastMCP, Pydantic.Retrieval and vector search (pgvector or similar).Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or equivalent). Kubernetes or similar container orchestration, beyond Docker.Public cloud, AWS preferred.Event-driven architecture (Kafka, CDC/streaming).Big-data / analytics warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift).Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot) - you'll integrate closely with our JVM platform.#LI-MK1

Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV Charging and Energy Management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers. 

We offer a scalable, integrated SaaS solution that enables our clients to efficiently manage their networks and provide EV drivers with exceptional charging experience. 

Operating in over 35 countries in the US, Europe and Asia, we enable hundreds of millions of events for millions of EV drivers and manage more than 160,000 public chargers (100,000s in roaming). 

Our customers include global industry leaders such as EVgo, Volvo Group, Shell, Circle K, Mer, Recharge, Kople, ESB, CEZ, MOL Group, ST1, and eMobility Power. 

WHO IS VONTIER
Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.

Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry.

With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com

At Vontier, we empower you to steer your career in the direction of success with a dynamic, innovative, and inclusive environment.

Our commitment to personal growth, work-life balance, and collaboration fuels a culture where your contributions drive meaningful change. We provide the roadmap for continuous learning, allowing creativity to flourish and ideas to accelerate into impactful solutions that contribute to a sustainable future.

Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. At Vontier, you are not on this journey alone, we are committed to equipping you with the tools and support you need to fuel your innovation, lead with impact, and thrive both personally and professionally.

Together, let’s power the way the world moves!

Job Description6Sense

RequirementsAbout the Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python) to design, build, and scale highly reliable backend systems and APIs. This role requires deep backend expertise, strong system design skills, and the ability to operate production-grade distributed systems in a cloud-native environment.
Depending on team needs, engineers may focus on product backend systems or platform and foundational infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong experience with Python using FastAPI and/or Django
Expertise in REST API design and implementation
Strong database knowledge: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and exposure to NoSQL / analytical stores (SingleStore, Hive)
Hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-based architectures
Experience building and operating scalable, distributed systems
Strong understanding of system design, performance, and reliability
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

Job ResponsibilitiesCore Responsibilities (All Engineers)
Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python (FastAPI / Django)
Build and evolve robust REST APIs with strong performance, security, and scalability
Design and optimize data models and queries across SQL and NoSQL systems
Architect and implement scalable distributed systems
Leverage AWS services and contribute to CI/CD pipelines
Ensure high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation
Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and code reviews
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Frontend, Data, and GTM teams
Support production systems and contribute to operational excellence

 

Nice-to-Have Skills (Product / Backend-Focused)
Experience with Java in backend systems
Event streaming and messaging exposure: Kafka, Kinesis, RabbitMQ, SQS, SNS, Redis
Infrastructure and deployment tooling: Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions
Monitoring and observability: Observe, Datadog, CloudWatch
CRM and email system integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, SMTP/ESP APIs, DKIM/SPF/DMARC)
Distributed systems patterns: idempotency, retries, circuit breakers, resiliency
Prior experience with production support or on-call rotations
Nice-to-Have Skills (Platform / Infrastructure)
Experience working with Platform or Core Infrastructure teams
Ability to design clean abstractions and foundational systems
Strong experience with CI/CD platforms and developer productivity & tooling
Deep familiarity with observability stacks and operational metrics
Experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and container orchestration
Designing and maintaining testing platforms and frameworks
Strong problem decomposition and product mindset
Experience building AI/LLM-powered systems using LangChain / OpenAI APIs
Data pipelines and big data technologies: Spark, Hive, Flink, Airflow
Knowledge of secure data lifecycle, GDPR, and privacy best practices
Testing experience using Pytest, Playwright, Jest

What we offerExciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.

Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities! 

Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we  host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and  GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

About GlobalLogicGlobalLogic is a full-lifecycle product development services leader that combines chip-to-cloud software engineering expertise and vertical industry experience to help our customers design, build, and deliver their next-generation products and digital experiences. We expertly integrate design, complex engineering, and agile delivery capabilities to deliver superior business outcomes for global brands in telecom, automotive, healthcare, technology, media and entertainment, manufacturing, and semiconductor industries.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, GlobalLogic employs over 25,000 designers and engineers across the globe. Analysts like NASSCOM and Zinnov have recognized us for being a top company in our field, and we are consistently nominated as a preferred employer by both global HR consultative firms and local job boards. By creating a work environment that is exciting and flexible, and by fostering growth through ongoing learning and development programs, we empower our employees to achieve both their professional and personal goals.

At GlobalLogic, we make amazing products — and careers.
